description: Deliberately style-sloppy legacy file: redundant else, nested ternary, count()>0, triple nesting, untyped properties and params, no strict_types.
notes: The offload verification, and its boundary. The eight §2 rules that moved to Rector/PHPStan/Pint must stay silent even though the code visibly trips every one of them. Two must still fire: §2b (missing param/return types — the lens keeps this because only a reader can tell a deliberate `mixed` from a placeholder) and §2a (the diff adds methods to a legacy file with no strict_types — and a tool can insert that line but cannot judge whether the file survives it, which is why §2a was NOT offloaded). §2c is the contrast to §2a: property types ARE mechanical, so `private $palette` must draw silence.
